005package org.wpilib.hardware.discrete;
006
007import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.DIOJNI;
008import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDevice;
009import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable;
010import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
011import org.wpilib.util.UsageReporting;
012
013/**
014 * Class to write digital outputs. This class will write digital outputs. Other devices that are
015 * implemented elsewhere will automatically allocate digital inputs and outputs as required.
016 */
017public class DigitalOutput implements AutoCloseable, TelemetryLoggable {
018  private static final int invalidPwmGenerator = 0;
019  private int m_pwmGenerator = invalidPwmGenerator;
020
021  private final int m_channel;
022  private int m_handle;
023
024  /**
025   * Create an instance of a digital output. Create an instance of a digital output given a channel.
026   *
027   * @param channel the SmartIO channel to use for the digital output.
028   */
029  public DigitalOutput(int channel) {
030    m_channel = channel;
031
032    m_handle = DIOJNI.initializeDIOPort(channel, false);
033
034    UsageReporting.reportUsage("IO", channel, "DigitalOutput");
035  }
036
037  @Override
038  public void close() {
039    // Disable the pwm only if we have allocated it
040    if (m_pwmGenerator != invalidPwmGenerator) {
041      disablePWM();
042    }
043    DIOJNI.freeDIOPort(m_handle);
044    m_handle = 0;
045  }
046
047  /**
048   * Set the value of a digital output.
049   *
050   * @param value true is on, off is false
051   */
052  public void set(boolean value) {
053    DIOJNI.setDIO(m_handle, value);
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Gets the value being output from the Digital Output.
058   *
059   * @return the state of the digital output.
060   */
061  public boolean get() {
062    return DIOJNI.getDIO(m_handle);
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Get the GPIO channel number that this object represents.
067   *
068   * @return The GPIO channel number.
069   */
070  public int getChannel() {
071    return m_channel;
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Output a single pulse on the digital output line.
076   *
077   * <p>Send a single pulse on the digital output line where the pulse duration is specified in
078   * seconds. Maximum of 65535 microseconds.
079   *
080   * @param pulseLength The pulse length in seconds
081   */
082  public void pulse(final double pulseLength) {
083    DIOJNI.pulse(m_handle, pulseLength);
084  }
085
086  /**
087   * Determine if the pulse is still going. Determine if a previously started pulse is still going.
088   *
089   * @return true if pulsing
090   */
091  public boolean isPulsing() {
092    return DIOJNI.isPulsing(m_handle);
093  }
094
095  /**
096   * Change the PWM frequency of the PWM output on a Digital Output line.
097   *
098   * <p>The valid range is from 0.6 Hz to 19 kHz. The frequency resolution is logarithmic.
099   *
100   * <p>There is only one PWM frequency for all channels.
101   *
102   * @param rate The frequency to output all digital output PWM signals.
103   */
104  public void setPWMRate(double rate) {
105    DIOJNI.setDigitalPWMRate(rate);
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * Enable a PWM PPS (Pulse Per Second) Output on this line.
110   *
111   * <p>Allocate one of the 6 DO PWM generator resources.
112   *
113   * <p>Supply the duty-cycle to output.
114   *
115   * <p>The resolution of the duty cycle is 8-bit.
116   *
117   * @param dutyCycle The duty-cycle to start generating. [0..1]
118   */
119  public void enablePPS(double dutyCycle) {
120    if (m_pwmGenerator != invalidPwmGenerator) {
121      return;
122    }
123    m_pwmGenerator = DIOJNI.allocateDigitalPWM();
124    DIOJNI.setDigitalPWMPPS(m_pwmGenerator, dutyCycle);
125    DIOJNI.setDigitalPWMOutputChannel(m_pwmGenerator, m_channel);
126  }
127
128  /**
129   * Enable a PWM Output on this line.
130   *
131   * <p>Allocate one of the 6 DO PWM generator resources.
132   *
133   * <p>Supply the initial duty-cycle to output in order to avoid a glitch when first starting.
134   *
135   * <p>The resolution of the duty cycle is 8-bit for low frequencies (1kHz or less) but is reduced
136   * the higher the frequency of the PWM signal is.
137   *
138   * @param initialDutyCycle The duty-cycle to start generating. [0..1]
139   */
140  public void enablePWM(double initialDutyCycle) {
141    if (m_pwmGenerator != invalidPwmGenerator) {
142      return;
143    }
144    m_pwmGenerator = DIOJNI.allocateDigitalPWM();
145    DIOJNI.setDigitalPWMDutyCycle(m_pwmGenerator, initialDutyCycle);
146    DIOJNI.setDigitalPWMOutputChannel(m_pwmGenerator, m_channel);
147  }
148
149  /**
150   * Change this line from a PWM output back to a static Digital Output line.
151   *
152   * <p>Free up one of the 6 DO PWM generator resources that were in use.
153   */
154  public void disablePWM() {
155    if (m_pwmGenerator == invalidPwmGenerator) {
156      return;
157    }
158    DIOJNI.freeDigitalPWM(m_pwmGenerator);
159    m_pwmGenerator = invalidPwmGenerator;
160  }
161
162  /**
163   * Change the duty-cycle that is being generated on the line.
164   *
165   * <p>The resolution of the duty cycle is 8-bit for low frequencies (1kHz or less) but is reduced
166   * the higher the frequency of the PWM signal is.
167   *
168   * @param dutyCycle The duty-cycle to change to. [0..1]
169   */
170  public void updateDutyCycle(double dutyCycle) {
171    if (m_pwmGenerator == invalidPwmGenerator) {
172      return;
173    }
174    DIOJNI.setDigitalPWMDutyCycle(m_pwmGenerator, dutyCycle);
175  }
176
177  /**
178   * Indicates this input is used by a simulated device.
179   *
180   * @param device simulated device handle
181   */
182  public void setSimDevice(SimDevice device) {
183    DIOJNI.setDIOSimDevice(m_handle, device.getNativeHandle());
184  }
185
186  @Override
187  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
188    table.log("Value", get());
189  }
190
191  @Override
192  public String getTelemetryType() {
193    return "Digital Output";
194  }
195}
